name: proton-mail-mcp
description: Search and read Proton Mail, write drafts and tidy the mailbox through Proton Mail Bridge, with a preview you approve before anything changes.
long_description: This bundle is only the connector. It runs `uvx mcp-proton-mail@1.30.1 connect`, which passes the client's requests to the proton-mail-mcp service on 127.0.0.1 and reads the service's bearer token from the system credential store each time it starts, so the token is never in the client's settings. It needs [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/), which downloads the package from PyPI, and Python 3.12 when there is none. Run `proton-mail-mcp setup` on this computer first: it installs Proton Mail Bridge, stores the credentials and starts the service. Everything runs on this computer; nothing is hosted. Unofficial: not affiliated with or endorsed by Proton AG.

env_file.title: Settings file (optional)
env_file.description: The proton-mail-mcp.env that `proton-mail-mcp setup` wrote. Leave it empty to use the one on this computer. The Bridge account, the port and the credential store come from this file; the bundle never asks for a password or a token.
